description: A local-first browser canvas for connecting, generating, inspecting and regenerating artifact nodes through a filesystem-backed registry and agent scripts.
scope_audience: Closed experimental application for an agent or creator composing text, image, audio and video artifacts as inspectable files; authenticated Codex CLI is required for real generation.

creativity.reason: The node graph joins prompts, named inputs, scripts, manifests and actual artifacts in a local-first workflow; global novelty versus other agent canvases is unknown.

current_usefulness.reason: Source and UI describe useful graph editing and generation paths, but real authenticated generation and user workflow were not exercised.

expected_usefulness.reason: If the stated composition workflow works reliably, inspectable artifact lineage and repair/regeneration provide a meaningful creator capability; collaboration is out of scope.

impl_progress.reason: Server routes, registry, workspace persistence, UI and tests are present; project status records local test entry points, but none ran here.

presentability.reason: README has a canvas illustration, requirements, quickstart, mental model and test commands and discloses the Codex requirement; fresh-user execution is unverified.

verification: README, status and representative HTTP/server/workspace generation route inspected; no npm commands, authenticated Codex use or browser review.

evidence.locator: What you can do today; Quick start; Mental model

contribution: The concrete differentiating thesis is inspectable, manifest-backed artifact composition and lineage on a local canvas; reliability and breadth are not independently demonstrated here.

delivery_likelihood.reason: The project records a completed experimental milestone with source and tests, but real generation still depends on an authenticated external CLI.

reason: The documented app is a coherent inspectable user-facing slice and merits fresh workflow verification; no superiority or production claim is made.
next_step: On a safe local workspace, verify one generation, inspect its manifest/artifact and test a failed-generation recovery before featuring it.
